premises.text: Insurance brokers cannot rebate commissions to clients, so Zenefits instead gives free HR/benefits software funded by those commissions
premises.evidence_span: it's illegal for them to rebate any portion of that commission to their clients. So I can't give you guys money back, but what I can do is provide a whole lot of services and software for free

premises.text: HR-as-a-service platform manages payroll, benefits, and associated HR admin for free because revenue comes from insurance commissions
premises.evidence_span: we take on and manage all of your payroll, all of your benefits, all of the associated HR administrative work

premises.text: Companies connect existing payroll and benefits systems two-way without re-enrolling, or Zenefits can set them up online without faxing
premises.evidence_span: if you already have payroll and benefits you don't have to set anything up. You don't have to re enroll or switch anything you could just connect your existing systems

premises.text: Making Zenefits broker of record is a simple online flow that lets them manage benefits and collect ongoing commissions without changing plans or pricing
premises.evidence_span: If you want to add your health insurance benefits to our platform, you make us your broker

premises.text: Connected systems automate onboarding: hire with minimal fields, auto-generate docs, collect payroll/tax/I-9 info, and enroll employees in benefits
premises.evidence_span: once you've connected this stuff, we can start to mechanize it. We can start to replace people and paper with software and technology

domains.name: free HR platform funded by broker commissions

value.text: Employers get payroll, benefits, and HR admin automated and free, removing administrative headaches
value.evidence_span: if we can take all these headaches off your hands, that's got to be something that's got to make sense for you to switch to us

causal_links.evidence_span: We do all of it for free, because we make money on the insurance commissions
just connect your existing systems to our platform
the least amount of work that is physically possible to do for you to hire someone

notes: Onboarding step cascade folded into one automation premise (v1.5.1 §4.1.7). Broker-of-record economics kept with the free-platform commercial mechanism; connectivity split as separately revisable integration condition. Competitive disruption rhetoric not coded as premises.
